IMPORTANT:
Set the workflow timezone before activating.
Workflow Settings → Timezone

SETUP REQUIRED

1. Connect a Google Calendar credential.
2. Select the calendar to monitor.
3. Connect a Gmail credential.
4. Open “Workflow Settings” and enter the recipient email.
5. Open workflow settings and choose the correct timezone.
6. Set the desired daily trigger time.
7. Test the workflow before publishing.
